title: A merge patch with an empty object turns a scalar member into an empty mapping
notes: MergePatch(Target, Patch): when Patch is an object and Target is not, Target becomes an empty object first; with nothing to merge the result is `{}`. The scalar `x` is therefore replaced, not kept.

provenance.reference: Found by comparing random edits of random documents with a plain model while building a lossless document for a Python library.
